objective: Measure D on fresh planted instances of rand 2.1 and local window 10 at n = 3200; then test speculative merges (A0 always, tuned A if D passes) against Novelty+ and a random-pair control with five runs per instance on rand 2.1 at 3200 and 12800, rand 3.0 and local window 10 at 3200.
status: Reading 5 by the frozen rule (no win anywhere): gate D passed on both families (co-flip pairs agree with the planted relative values 0.66-0.75 against 0.55-0.63 on rand 2.1; provably tied 2.5x as often on local w10), but every speculative arm lost on every random cell (A 1.17 [1.13, 1.33] on the primary, AE 2.26, 1.21-1.85 at 12800, 2.25-4.40 on rand 3.0) and none won on local w10 (best Aloc 1.41; the proof-based Gpr 0.15); merge precision about 0.7 on rand; the undo rule undid 85% of correct rounds and kept 9% of wrong ones (A93 overturned). Computed, referee pending.
title: Co-flip evidence as a guide (gate D) and speculative merges with un-merge (A) between epochs of Novelty+
